tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The provisions of section 590h(g) of title 16, relating to assignment of payments, shall apply to payments made under this chapter.

tree.heading: Notice
tree.text: The producer making the assignment, or the assignee, shall provide the Secretary with notice, in such manner as the Secretary may require, of any assignment made under this section.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in subsec. (a), was in the original “this title”, meaning title I of Pub. L. 113–79, Feb. 7, 2014, 128 Stat. 649, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of title I to the Code, see Tables.
